messages:
tayla (partnerships): Quick thread for a connector sample-app + certification roadmap. Partner wants Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant demo app in marketplace tile. Need cert steps for A100 vs A30 hardware and a short ops runbook for customers. owners?
owen (eng-ml): I can own the sample-app integration. plan: python ingest script, streaming query example, and a notebook for Databricks. will reuse existing connector code but need to validate Snowflake External Function path.
diego (partner-eng): FYI partner asked for a "single-click" deploy for the sample app (CloudFormation + Terraform) and a hardware compatibility blurb. I'll draft infra artifacts.
mei (product): timeline: partner wants a preview by Apr 10. legal needs a minimal data-flow and privacy bullets before we share. legal-bot, can you list docs required?
legal-bot: Required: data-flow diagram, PII handling notes, retention policy summary, partner SLA excerpt. See internal template: https://legal.redwood/templates/partner-share :book:
ci-bot: connector-ci: nightly run completed 2026-03-10T05:00Z. Databricks connector: all tests pass. Snowflake External Functions: 1 flaky test (auth header length).
owen (eng-ml): noted. I'll add robust header handling to the External Functions client. quick snippet I'll add to sample app: ```python
client = ExternalFunctionClient(retries=3, timeout=20)
```
diego (partner-eng): for hardware cert, partner expects A30/A100 pass + sample perf numbers. can infra provide screenshots of `nvidia-smi` and power/perf profiles?
tayla (partnerships): @diego coordinate with infra. also create a short checklist in drive and add owners. link will be in the invite.
mei (product): decision: target Apr 21 public listing unless everything green for partner preview Apr 10. owners: owen (sample app + Snowflake fix), diego (deploy artifacts + partner ops), mei (marketplace tile + legal sync), tayla (announce coordination).
owen (eng-ml): I'll push a branch with sample app and tests by Fri. will include a small README and metrics capture (ingest throughput, p99 query latency).
diego (partner-eng): I'll prototype the one-click deploy this week. quick note: for Snowflake we must document network setup for External Functions (eg, NAT/egress).
tayla (partnerships): great. I'll set weekly checkpoints and add partner to preview channel. ping #release-war-room for any blockers. :thumbsup:
